description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 1 February 2019, led by Lucario & Melmetal-GX, whose GX attack makes its player's Metal Pokémon take 30 less damage for the rest of the game, and Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX, whose GX attack can take extra Prize cards. Blastoise-GX, which can do 300 damage by shuffling five Water Energy back into the deck, and Celesteela-GX join them. The cards are numbered to 54, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Beast Bringer, Metal Core Barrier and Mt. Coronet. In English most of its cards came out in Unbroken Bonds in May 2019.
